subject: maths
question: The successive discounts of 29%, 18% and 9% are equivalent to a single discount of: (Rounded up to two decimal places.)
solution:
**Given:**

Successive discounts: 29%, 18%, and 9%.

**Formula Used:**

Single equivalent discount = 1 - (1 - d₁) × (1 - d₂) × (1 - d₃)

Where d₁, d₂, and d₃ are the individual discounts in decimal form.

**Calculation:**

d₁ = 29% = 0.29, d₂ = 18% = 0.18, d₃ = 9% = 0.09

Single equivalent discount = 1 - (1 - 0.29) × (1 - 0.18) × (1 - 0.09)

⇒ Single equivalent discount = 1 - (0.71 × 0.82 × 0.91)

⇒ Single equivalent discount = 1 - (0.529802)

⇒ Single equivalent discount = 0.470198

Rounded to two decimal places: 0.4702

**The single equivalent discount is 47.02%.**
